lines.text: "title": "Smaller diffs on mobile, plus an Iosevka toggle",

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.summary: Eval: add parts cases; accept a page-object part in cigster-99
lines.text:
"body": "## What

On mobile the diff text stayed at desktop size while the brief above it shrank, so long lines were cut off at the card edge. This shrinks diffs on narrow screens and adds a stored mono font choice.

- `--diff-font-size` / `--diff-line-height` step down at the same 799px breakpoint as the body text (13px/20px -> 11px/17px), applied on the `diffs-container` host so Pierre actually reads them. Mobile gutter padding slims with them.
- Narrow screens wrap diff lines by default; the wrap toggle still wins. `resolveWrap` in `src/ui/lib/narrow.ts`, covered by tests.
- File header on mobile: filename 12px, hunk count label hidden, change counts stay.
- Desktop unchanged: 13px/20px, scroll mode, full header.
- Iosevka bundled via `@fontsource/iosevka` (400/500) as an alternate mono. A small Aa toggle beside the theme toggle in both headers switches it; the choice is stored in localStorage (`comprehende.mono-font`, default IBM Plex Mono). The latin woff2 (~1 MB/weight) downloads only when Iosevka is first selected.

## Test

- `src/ui/lib/narrow.test.ts` and `src/ui/lib/mono-font.test.ts` pass; UI typecheck clean.
- Verified in a browser at 390px: diff lines compute 11px/17px (was 13px/20px), Iosevka toggle persists across reload.
- No `skills-next/`, `src/schema/`, or `src/review/` changes, so no eval run.

Hosted review: https://matemolnar8.github.io/comprehende/pr/143/",
